item.title: [6.8] On first-order meta-learning algorithms
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections.

WHY IT MATTERS

Introduces PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement in robotics using a single frozen model, showing measurable performance gains on RoboDojo tasks.
